newsitem.title: USA: News Corp names pres/COO, management office.
newsitem.headline: News Corp names pres/COO, management office.

text.p: News Corp said on Tuesday that Peter Chernin has been appointed president and chief operating officer, and Chase Carey has been named co-chief operating officer.
The company said North American operations of News Corp will be consolidated under its Fox Group, of which Chernin will be chairman and chief executive.
Carey will continue as chairman and chief executive of Fox Television Group, which falls under the Fox Group.
News Corp said it also has established an Office of the Chairman, which will have management responsibility for its worldwide operations.
